# api-lifecycle

Lifecycle from draft to deprecation - contract-first, dated deprecation, measured retirement.

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-BREAK-005` | medium | Deprecation is dated, announced and measurable |
| `AF-BREAK-006` | medium | Semantic-version the contract, not the implementation |
| `AF-CONTRACT-001` | high | Contract operation has no implementation |
